plugin.name: Neko Live Album
plugin.description: A two-way Live Photo album that feels like a girlfriend: capture your catgirl's reactions with a shutter button, and she may ask to take a Live Photo of you with the front camera. Long-press any card to replay the moment. The album persists locally and supports sharing.
entry.album_guide.name: Live Album Guide
entry.album_guide.description: Explains how the Live Album works: how to photograph the catgirl, how to let her photograph you, and how to replay live moments. Call this when the user asks about the album or photo features.
entry.album_guide.text: Open the Live Album panel: tap the catgirl's head to pet her; press "Photograph her" to capture a 2.5s reaction live clip; press "She photographs you" (or wait for her to shyly ask) and after consent she will use the front camera to take a live photo of you; long-press any photo in the album to replay the live moment.
entry.photo_react.name: Generate Photo Reaction
entry.photo_react.description: Returns a line the catgirl would say during a photo moment. scene options: shy (caught off guard), pose (striking a pose), happy (delighted), annoyed (playful complaint), compliment (praising the user after their photo).
